title: Count the positives with fold_left
starter:
let count_positive l =
  List.fold_left (fun acc x -> acc) 0 l
hints: `acc` is the count so far. For each `x`, decide whether the count goes up by one or stays the same.
`(fun acc x -> if x > 0 then acc + 1 else acc)`

answer.code:
let count_positive l =
  List.fold_left (fun acc x -> if x > 0 then acc + 1 else acc) 0 l
answer.explain: The accumulator starts at 0 and is the number of positives seen so far. For each element the function returns `acc + 1` when `x > 0` and `acc` otherwise, and `fold_left` hands that on to the next element.
